hints: In a directed graph, an edge to a vertex currently in the DFS recursion stack closes a directed cycle.
Track states unvisited, active, and finished, plus the parent vertex.
When an active neighbor is found, follow parents to reconstruct the cycle.
analogy: An edge back into the current chain closes a loop with the directed edges already followed.
algorithm: Run color-state DFS. On edge u->v with v active, collect u,parent[u],... until v, reverse, and append v; otherwise report IMPOSSIBLE.
correctness: The parent chain consists of directed DFS-tree edges from v to u, and the back edge u->v closes that valid directed cycle.
